title: The Road to Jerusalem
author: Guillou, Jan
review:
Definitely a bit of a setup book but interested in where the series goes. Book is fairly zoomed out and a bit of a history book at times that can make it feel impersonal but it also gives you more context of the historical period it takes place in.

This is pre Crusading but there's compelling thoughts on the contradiction of religion that preaches love and crusading against non believers and how the standards for masculinity are vastly different from what we know today. Also good stuff on how actual medieval Swedish settlements were run and the varying standards of food and drink have changed.
